newsitem.title: USA: TVA sees Tenn. nuke restarting Friday.
newsitem.headline: TVA sees Tenn. nuke restarting Friday.

text.p: TVA Nuclear said its 1,170 megawatt Watts Bar nuclear power plant will likely restart Friday after tripping off line Wednesday.
"We will be restarting the unit tomorrow, and the cause of the outage was a faulty water level control switch," company spokesman Tom Tohill said Thursday.
The plant, in Spring City, Tenn., tripped off line Wednesday after the main feedwater pumps automatically shut down.
Firm, peak power prices into TVA for Friday delivery were talked earlier Thursday in the $15.00-17.50 per megawatt hour range.
